select record.id id, detail.id as purchaseDetailId, record.quantity as quantity, record.mete as mete, record.create_time as applicantDate, record.measure_unit as unit, record.accounting_unit as accountingUnit, record.actual_received_mete as actualReceivedMete, record.reject_quantity as rejectQuantity, record.reject_mete as rejectMete, record.reject_actual_received_mete as rejectActualReceivedMete, operate.user_id as 'applicant.id', operate.user_name as 'applicant.name' from project_receiving_record record left join scm_purchase_order_detail detail on detail.id = record.purchase_details_id and detail.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join project_purchase_order_received_operate_record as operate on operate.id = record.operate_record_id where record.bool_delete_enum = 0 and record.source_type = 2
and record.purchase_details_id in
#{item}
order by record.create_time desc
